visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with short dark hair, wearing a dark blue puff-sleeve top with a white eyelet lace hem and beige corduroy pants, lies face down on a light-colored wood floor in a brightly lit room. She rests her head on her arm, looking away from the camera. (2) The toddler pushes herself up using her hands and transition to a crawling position before standing up fully. The camera remains at a low angle, capturing her movements from behind as she begins to move across the room. (3) The toddler walks confidently down a narrow hallway. Along the left side of the hallway, several white plates with small amounts of food are lined up on the wood floor. The camera follows her walking towards a more open area of the house. (4) The toddler reaches a small cream-colored indoor slide. She climbs the short steps and slides down onto a soft gray mat. To the left of the slide, a tortoiseshell cat is curled up in a cat bed next to a vintage-style space heater. (5) After sliding, the toddler waves to the cat and then crawls onto a large gray floor cushion positioned next to the cat's bed. She lies down on her side on the cushion, mimicking the cat's sleeping posture. (6) The toddler eventually stands up from the cushion and walks toward a small white bookshelf filled with colorful children's books and a small white stool, indicating she has finished her 'nap'.
